mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which in turn results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points in a single month indicates a tightening labor market, which can lead to increased wage pressures and inflation expectations, driving the S&P 500 forward returns positively over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for broader economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the periods following a sustained increase in housing starts, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals strong consumer demand, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a single month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points in the same quarter, it signals strong economic growth coupled with a tightening labor market, which is a positive indicator for corporate earnings and thus drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% QoQ and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this mechanism is below 0.04 over a 3-year rolling window.
